{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
patient_id_counts = data['patient_id'].value_counts()
duplicate_patients = patient_id_counts[patient_id_counts > 1]

duplicate_count = len(duplicate_patients)

print(f'Duplicate patient IDs: {duplicate_count}')
print(f'Number of unique patients: {data["patient_id"].nunique()}')
print(f'Total rows: {len(data)}')

# Check for sentinel value -999 in biomarker_baseline
sentinel_count = (data['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum()
print(f'Number of -999 values in biomarker_baseline: {sentinel_count}')

# Check if assay_batch affects biomarker_baseline (should not)
batch_baseline_stats = data.groupby('assay_batch')['biomarker_baseline'].agg(['mean', 'count'])
print('\nMean baseline biomarker by assay_batch:')
print(batch_baseline_stats)"}
